title: Bat Detector Quiet-Night Deviation
dataSources: iNaturalist observations (`inat:observation`), moth trap sessions (`mothtrap:session`), bat detections (`batdetector:pass`), and trail-cam label events (`trailcam:label`).
app: Backyard biodiversity telemetry from iNaturalist exports, moth-trap image batches, AudioMoth bat detectors, and trail-camera AI labeling pipelines sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=batdetector:pass
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as bat_passes by _time site_name
| streamstats window=7 avg(bat_passes) as trailing_avg by site_name
| eval deviation_pct=if(trailing_avg>0,round(100*(bat_passes-trailing_avg)/trailing_avg,1),0)
| sort deviation_pct
description: Examines quiet-night deviation for bat passes.
value: Quiet-night deviation helps you notice weather or hardware problems before a whole survey period is lost.
implementation: Send quiet-night deviation for bat passes events to `index=personal` with the fields used in this SPL and review the outliers or trend breaks regularly.
visualization: Table or chart of quiet-night deviation for bat passes, depending on the selected time range.
grandmaExplanation: It flags what is happening with quiet-night deviation for bat passes, so odd changes stand out quickly.
